$comment: Reference rows for the incident store. The product's storage range, excursion range and label provenance are REAL - pulled live from the openFDA drug label API and pinned in data/product_profile.json. Everything marked as a demo assumption below is ours and is labelled as such wherever it is displayed. The unit value in particular is a plausible wholesale figure, not a quoted price, and the value-at-risk headline is derived from it rather than chosen first.

products.name: Amoxicillin 500 mg capsules (A-S Medication Solutions)
products.allowance_source: ColdCall demo policy - NOT label text. Verified against openFDA: no real drug label states a permitted excursion duration. The 20-25C band and the 15-30C excursion range ARE label text.
products.label_provenance: openFDA drug label API, set_id e13cafe2-f226-4021-81d8-7bd1f98b5582: 'Store at 20 to 25C (68 to 77F); excursions permitted to 15 to 30C (59 to 86F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].'
